title: Power Stack sweep — tactical relief inside capital scarcity
regime: Capital scarcity remains structural; oil/yield relief is producing a tactical risk-on phase rather than a confirmed regime reversal.

structuralState.rates: Restrictive. Fed has hiked and another 2026 hike remains plausible; long-duration hurdle rates remain elevated.
structuralState.energy: Crude scarcity premium is easing, but product, freight and route inefficiency remain stressed.
structuralState.ai: Demand is resilient. The quality filter shifts toward contracted/funded capacity, backlog conversion and cash generation.
structuralState.breadth: Selective risk-on led by AI/semiconductors; do not read this as broad easing.

tacticalState.label: Risk-on relief / squeeze
evidence: Nasdaq futures were up about 1% on Sep 21 as AI/chip names rebounded.
Brent fell about 2% to roughly $101.7 as Saudi exports recovered and pipeline-restoration hopes improved.
Bonds rallied as the oil impulse eased.
tacticalState.invalidation: Oil reaccelerates, long yields resume their rise, or breadth weakens while AI beta rolls over.

categories.portfolioImpact: Keep valuation discipline. Treat lower yields as relief until the Fed path itself softens.
